## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON, Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive — confirmed by falling fear: VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION (↓ falling) and broad equity leadership: SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND; credit signal mixed with HYG/LQD flagged as rising stress.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION (↓ falling). Stocks vs Bonds RECOVERY: SPY/TLT (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -2.23%) ↑ rising. Credit stress RISING: Credit spread (HYG/LQD) signalled higher stress (Level: 0.7259 | 1W: +0.19% | 1M: -0.83%) → flat/RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (Dollar) RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.66%) ↑ rising and TLT (20+yr) ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) → flat, yield curve CORRECTION (Level: 1.0774 | 1W: -0.26% | 1M: +1.82%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy and Utilities leading: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLU (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging short-term in RECOVERY: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY — style: cyclicals showing strength vs growth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US showing resilience: SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND while EM strength is notable: EEM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; Japan soft intra-week: EWJ (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%) CORRECTION and China patchy: FXI (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.35%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculative flows mixed: IWM (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%) RECOVERY shows small-cap interest, while IBIT (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) RECOVERY highlights continued 1M weakness in crypto-linked assets.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Industrial and reflation elements intact: CPER (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) ABOVE TREND; SLV (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) RECOVERY remains volatile.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy bullish: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND; Natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: SPY ABOVE TREND (both 1W & 1M positive). DIVERGENCE: MAJOR — multiple core ETFs (XLK, QQQ, IWM) show RECOVERY (1W positive, 1M negative), tempering conviction despite broad breadth.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposure (XLE, XLB) given broad sector strength; reduce exposure to longer-duration/high-volatility thematics and crypto-linked ETFs (ARKK, IBIT) until 1M momentum stabilizes.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND; XLB (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY; KWEB (1W: -0.27% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND; TAN (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +14.39%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND; SLV (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) RECOVERY — watch reversion risk.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~28 (complacency elevated), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health trigger), SPY/TLT ~7.7 (risk vs rates pivot), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (style rotation monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, confirmed by falling VXX and SPY ABOVE TREND. Energy and cyclicals (XLE, XLB) are showing relative strength while Tech (XLK) is in RECOVERY. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (XLK/QQQ/IWM RECOVERY) and mixed credit signals to monitor.
